newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 5.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's edition of Daily Variety:

HOLLYWOOD - Chris McGurk, the former Walt Disney Studio motion picture group president, has landed at MCA Inc of Seagram Co Ltd as chief operating officer of the motion picture group. McGurk takes over duties from Lynwood Spinks, who was tapped by MCA in January as executive vice president of the motion picture group involved in international deal-making, film acquisitions and strategic planning.

HOLLYWOOD - Dana Walden has been named head of drama for 20th Century Fox Television, where she will oversee all drama series produced by the News Corp division and supervise drama development. Walden most recently had been vice president of programming.
